```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(mocapr)

sess_fixed <- read_csv("session1_fixed.csv")
sess2      <- read_csv("session2_clean.csv")

both_sess <- bind_rows(
  sess_fixed |> mutate(session = "Session 1"),
  sess2
)

count(both_sess, session, skeleton)

as <- both_sess |>
  filter(skeleton %in% c("Alexia", "Simon")) |>
  group_by(session, skeleton) |>
  arrange(frame, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(speed_ms = sqrt((CGX - lag(CGX))^2 + (CGZ - lag(CGZ))^2) / 1000 * 50) |>
  ungroup()

as |>
  group_by(skeleton, session) |>
  summarise(mean_speed_ms = mean(speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
            distance_m    = sum(speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE) / 50,
            .groups = "drop")
as |>
  mutate(window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
  group_by(session, skeleton, window) |>
  summarise(mean_speed = mean(speed_ms, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(window, mean_speed, colour = session)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ skeleton, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Mean speed (m/s)", colour = NULL)

ggplot(as, aes(CGX, CGZ, colour = time_seconds)) +
  geom_path() +
  coord_equal() +
  facet_grid(session ~ skeleton) +
  scale_colour_viridis_c()

follow_windows <- function(data, leader, follower, delays = 0:300) {
  pair <- inner_join(
    data |> filter(skeleton == leader) |>
      select(frame, time_seconds, leader_x = CGX, leader_z = CGZ),
    data |> filter(skeleton == follower) |>
      select(frame, follower_x = CGX, follower_z = CGZ),
    by = "frame"
  )

  map(delays, \(d)
    pair |>
      mutate(lx = lag(leader_x, d), lz = lag(leader_z, d),
             window = floor(time_seconds / 10) * 10) |>
      group_by(window) |>
      summarise(mean_gap_m = mean(sqrt((lx - follower_x)^2 +
                                       (lz - follower_z)^2), na.rm = TRUE) / 1000,
                .groups = "drop") |> mutate(delay_s = d / 50)
  ) |>
    list_rbind() |>
    group_by(window) |>
    slice_min(mean_gap_m, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(leader = leader, follower = follower)
}
s2_K <- follow_windows(sess2, "Kevin",  "Bahar") |> mutate(session = "Session 2")
s2_A <- follow_windows(sess2, "Alexia", "Simon") |> mutate(session = "Session 2")

s1_K <- follow_windows(sess_fixed, "Kevin",  "Bahar") |> mutate(session = "Session 1")
s1_A <- follow_windows(sess_fixed, "Alexia", "Simon") |> mutate(session = "Session 1")

leading <- bind_rows(s1_K, s1_A, s2_K, s2_A) |>
  filter(window > 0, window < 120) |>
  mutate(following = mean_gap_m < 0.5 & delay_s > 0 & delay_s < 6)

ggplot(leading, aes(window, delay_s, colour = session)) +
  geom_line(data = filter(leading, following)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = mean_gap_m, shape = following)) +
  facet_wrap(~ leader, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Follower delay (s)", colour = NULL,
       size = "Gap (m)", shape = "Following?")
       
nrow(s1_K)
nrow(s1_A)

unique(sess_fixed$skeleton)

joints<- c("LW", "LE", "LS", "RW", "RE", "RS",
              "LH", "LK", "LA", "LT", "RH", "RK", "RA", "RT")
pos_cols <- paste0(rep(joints, each = 3), c("X", "Y", "Z"))
pos_cols
kin_long <- sess2 |>
  filter(frame %% 5 == 0) |>

kin <- kin_long |>

ggplot(kin, aes(time_seconds, volume_m3, colour = skeleton)) +

kin |> group_by(skeleton) |> summarise(median_volume = median(volume_m3)) 
ggplot(kin, aes(time_seconds, volume_m3)) +
  geom_line() +

install.packages("crqa")
library(crqa)

joints <- c("LW", "LE", "LS", "RW", "RE", "RS",
            "LH", "LK", "LA", "LT", "RH", "RK", "RA", "RT")
xcols <- paste0(joints, "X"); ycols <- paste0(joints, "Y"); zcols <- paste0(joints, "Z")

alexia2 <- sess2 |>
  filter(skeleton == "Alexia", frame %% 5 == 0) |>
  arrange(frame) |>
  mutate(pelvX = (LHX + RHX) / 2,
         pelvY = (LHY + RHY) / 2,
         pelvZ = (LHZ + RHZ) / 2) |>
  mutate(across(all_of(xcols), \(v) v - pelvX),
         across(all_of(ycols), \(v) v - pelvY),
         across(all_of(zcols), \(v) v - pelvZ))

pc <- prcomp(alexia2 |> select(all_of(c(xcols, ycols, zcols))))
summary(pc)$importance[, 1:5]

X <- pc$x[, 1:3]

win  <- 40   # 4 s at 10 Hz
step <- 5    # move by 0.5 s
starts <- seq(1, nrow(X) - win + 1, by = step)

rqa_alexia2 <- map(starts, \(s) {
  Xw <- X[s:(s + win - 1), ]
  d  <- as.matrix(dist(Xw))
  r  <- max(quantile(d[upper.tri(d)], 0.05), 1e-6)
  res <- crqa(Xw, Xw, delay = 1, embed = 1, rescale = 0, radius = r,
              normalize = 0, mindiagline = 2, minvertline = 2, tw = 0,
              whiteline = FALSE, recpt = FALSE, side = "upper",
              method = "mdcrqa", metric = "euclidean", datatype = "continuous")
  tibble(time_s = (s - 1) / 10 + 2,
         RR = res$RR, DET = res$DET, L = res$L, LAM = res$LAM, ENTR = res$ENTR)
}) |> list_rbind()

rqa_alexia2 |>
  pivot_longer(c(DET, LAM), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(time_s, value)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "%")

summary(rqa_alexia2$RR)

rqa_alexia2 |>
  mutate(window = floor(time_s / 10) * 10) |>
  group_by(window) |>
  summarise(DET = mean(DET), LAM = mean(LAM))

auto_rqa <- function(data, who, win = 40, step = 5) {
  p <- data |>
    filter(skeleton == who, frame %% 5 == 0) |>
    arrange(frame) |>
    mutate(pelvX = (LHX + RHX) / 2, pelvY = (LHY + RHY) / 2, pelvZ = (LHZ + RHZ) / 2) |>
    mutate(across(all_of(xcols), \(v) v - pelvX),
           across(all_of(ycols), \(v) v - pelvY),
           across(all_of(zcols), \(v) v - pelvZ))
  X <- prcomp(p |> select(all_of(c(xcols, ycols, zcols))))$x[, 1:3]
  starts <- seq(1, nrow(X) - win + 1, by = step)
  map(starts, \(s) {
    Xw <- X[s:(s + win - 1), ]
    d  <- as.matrix(dist(Xw))
    r  <- max(quantile(d[upper.tri(d)], 0.05), 1e-6)
    res <- crqa(Xw, Xw, delay = 1, embed = 1, rescale = 0, radius = r,
                normalize = 0, mindiagline = 2, minvertline = 2, tw = 0,
                whiteline = FALSE, recpt = FALSE, side = "upper",
                method = "mdcrqa", metric = "euclidean", datatype = "continuous")
    tibble(skeleton = who, time_s = p$time_seconds[s] + win / 20,
           RR = res$RR, DET = res$DET, L = res$L, LAM = res$LAM, ENTR = res$ENTR)
  }) |> list_rbind()
}

rqa_s2 <- map(c("Alexia", "Bahar", "Kevin", "Simon"), \(w) auto_rqa(sess2, w)) |>
  list_rbind() |> mutate(session = "Session 2")

rqa_s1 <- map(c("Alexia", "Bahar", "Kevin", "Luc", "Simon", "Sol"), \(w) auto_rqa(sess_fixed, w)) |>
  list_rbind() |> mutate(session = "Session 1")

bind_rows(rqa_s1, rqa_s2) |>
  group_by(skeleton, session) |>
  summarise(DET = mean(DET), L = mean(L), LAM = mean(LAM), .groups = "drop")

qom10 <- function(data, who) {
  p <- data |> filter(skeleton == who) |> arrange(frame)
  spd <- map(joints, \(j)
    sqrt((p[[paste0(j, "X")]] - lag(p[[paste0(j, "X")]]))^2 +
         (p[[paste0(j, "Y")]] - lag(p[[paste0(j, "Y")]]))^2 +
         (p[[paste0(j, "Z")]] - lag(p[[paste0(j, "Z")]]))^2)
  ) |> reduce(`+`)
  tibble(frame = p$frame, qom = spd / 1000 * 50) |>
    group_by(block = frame %/% 5) |>
    summarise(time_s = min(frame) / 50, qom = mean(qom, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(qom_z = (qom - mean(qom, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(qom, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    select(time_s, qom_z)
}

pairQ <- inner_join(qom10(sess2, "Kevin"), qom10(sess2, "Bahar"),
                    by = "time_s", suffix = c("_A", "_B")) |>
  drop_na()

ac  <- acf(pairQ$qom_z_A, lag.max = 20, plot = FALSE)$acf[-1]
tau <- if (any(ac <= 0)) which(ac <= 0)[1] else 20
m   <- 3

embed_ts <- function(x, m, tau) {
  n <- length(x) - (m - 1) * tau
  sapply(0:(m - 1), \(i) x[1:n + i * tau])
}
EA <- embed_ts(pairQ$qom_z_A, m, tau)
EB <- embed_ts(pairQ$qom_z_B, m, tau)
tA <- pairQ$time_s[1:nrow(EA)]
tau

win <- 40; step <- 5
starts <- seq(1, nrow(EA) - win + 1, by = step)

xrqa_KB <- map(starts, \(s) {
  Aw <- EA[s:(s + win - 1), ]; Bw <- EB[s:(s + win - 1), ]
  d  <- as.matrix(dist(rbind(Aw, Bw)))[1:win, (win + 1):(2 * win)]
  r  <- max(quantile(d, 0.05), 1e-6)
  res <- crqa(Aw, Bw, delay = 1, embed = 1, rescale = 0, radius = r,
              normalize = 0, mindiagline = 2, minvertline = 2, tw = 0,
              whiteline = FALSE, recpt = FALSE, side = "both",
              method = "mdcrqa", metric = "euclidean", datatype = "continuous")
  tibble(time_s = tA[s] + win / 20, RR = res$RR, DET = res$DET)
}) |> list_rbind()

ggplot(xrqa_KB, aes(time_s, DET)) + geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Cross-DET (%)")

d_all <- as.matrix(dist(rbind(EA, EB)))[1:nrow(EA), (nrow(EA) + 1):(2 * nrow(EA))]
r_all <- quantile(d_all, 0.05)
maxLag <- 40   # 4 s

prof_KB <- map(-maxLag:maxLag, \(k) {
  i <- if (k >= 0) 1:(nrow(EA) - k) else (1 - k):nrow(EA)
  tibble(lag_s = k / 10,
         rr = mean(sqrt(rowSums((EA[i, ] - EB[i + k, ])^2)) < r_all))
}) |> list_rbind()

ggplot(prof_KB, aes(lag_s, rr)) +
  geom_line() + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "Lag (s)   (+ = Kevin leads, − = Bahar leads)", y = "Recurrence rate")
```
